status: User approved existing numerical assumptions for one bounded Stage 1-A state PPO seed 0 experiment. Not hardware safety limits or final agile-flight acceptance.
initial_state_frame: Position perturbations use the proper target frame [-registered slope, registered across, outward normal]; velocity is world-frame, attitude is a rotation vector about the nominal world-aligned body, angular velocity is body-frame. No reference trajectory or action labels.
contact_region_status: Existing registered central ray-audit footprint, not an official scoring region. Numerical gates are user-approved for this simulation-only baseline. Physical compressive contact by the assumed S1c underside fixture is necessary; proximity is insufficient. Orientation gate compares body positive Z with surface normal; yaw about that normal is unconstrained for the axisymmetric assumed sphere. Plane error tolerance is a proposal, not a correction to the registered physical surface.
reward_status: PerchRL-inspired bounded guidance and near-target alignment plus command magnitude/smoothness, speed/rate and time costs. Coefficients are new engineering proposals; no energy optimization, imitation, prescribed trajectory or prescribed attitude timetable. Independent contact scoring never reads these weights.
